name: dev-tools
description: Daily developer tools in one plugin. Skill `logs`: a service's application logs on one environment (Kibana/Elasticsearch, read-only), summary, errors grouped by message shape, recent lines, pods. Skill `jira`: Jira Server/DC issues, read-only, through dev-cli (presets or JQL, cached digest, one issue in full). Skill `telegram`: one file or a short message to the configured Telegram group through dev-cli, checked first. Agents: log-analyst (Sonnet, one per service in parallel), jira-reader (Haiku), telegram-sender (Haiku). Settings in ~/.dev-cli/.env. Formerly app-logs, jira-issues and telegram-send.
